data.name: Althee
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Althee is derived from αλθεια (althaea), meaning 'healing' or 'curing'. The name has roots in the Greek goddess of healing, Aletheia, who was believed to bring truth and dispel illusion. In the Christian context, Althee can symbolize spiritual healing and God's grace in times of need.
